Lyft Bike:
Member-only perks

For less than a dollar a day, you get unlimited 45-minute rides on classic bikes, reduced ebike prices, $0 unlocks, and a whole lot more.

Single rides

Great for one-way trips. Just download the app and you're ready to roll.

Day pass

When you've got lots to do. Includes unlimited 30-min classic bike rides within a 24-hour period. Any ride longer than 30 min is an extra $0.19/min. Upgrading to an ebike is also $0.49/min.
